name: RC-B10-0371/2025 – § 4 – Am 4
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the detention of EU citizens in the occupied areas of Cyprus
part_text: 4.Urges theCommission and theEuropean External Action Service to take immediate and decisive initiatives exerting their influence on Türkiye and to take all necessary diplomatic, political and legal measures, includingconsidering punitivemeasures, to secure their release;
